author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as two bottles on a bench with a stray ring: the patient's body was a bare bar and the head floated. Redrawn with a lying patient (body pill with r4 caps, head r4 exactly 8 beside the shoulder cap, marked as a human figure) on a massage table, and a cupping glass (bell with walls and dome) with its rubber bulb on the back. Reads as cupping on a patient at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Reference's two cups reduced to one: two 8-wide bells plus the 8-unit gaps and the detached head don't fit the 40-unit width. Arm line on the body dropped. Massage table added for the lying context.
